scope: Independent QA of the reported green focus rectangle on interview voice entry and static discoverability of browser SpeechRecognition plus terminology/context correction.

reproduction: Enter精选面试题 and open Q1 direct practice, or switch interview panels.
Observe a green rectangle around the page h1.
evidence: focusTitle() sets tabindex=-1 and calls focus({preventScroll:true}) on app.querySelector('h1').
Multiple interview navigation and status paths call render();focusTitle().
styles.css has control :focus-visible rules but no h1 focus visual rule/reset.
User supplied screenshot shows the resulting green rectangle.
Minimal VM run reports tabindex=-1, focused=true, focusOptions.preventScroll=true.
focusFinding.retest: Capture activeElement, accessibility tree and desktop/390px screenshots after navigation and recording-state redraws.

limits: No real browser click/AX/screenshot was obtained in this run.
Chinese recognition accuracy and browser external processing were not verified.

regression.interpretation: Current code defaults browserSpeechOptIn=true; the failing checks still assert the previous opt-in contract. Tests must be updated and rerun, not counted as pass.

acceptance: Programmatic title focus remains screen-reader reachable without a large default green rectangle.
Keyboard focus rings remain visible for interactive controls.
Voice redraws do not repeatedly steal focus or focus a non-actionable title.
Default SpeechRecognition product contract and regression tests agree.
Node, voice smoke, browser speech, AX and screenshot evidence are rerun.
